scenes.text: What if Naruto joined the Akatsuki? The first surprise is that joining would not make him safe.
scenes.label: WHAT IF HE JOINED?

shots.match_reason: Itachi represents Akatsuki and the opposing faction

scenes.text: He carries the Nine Tails, and the Akatsuki wants the tailed beasts. Their new recruit is also their target.
scenes.label: RECRUIT OR TARGET?

shots.match_reason: Nine-Tails transformation illustrates the power discussed

scenes.text: In this alternate timeline, Naruto offers a deal: his help, in exchange for protecting his friends.
scenes.label: THE OFFER

shots.match_reason: Naruto and Sakura illustrate the friends he wants to protect
Hinata illustrates the personal stakes of protection

scenes.text: At first, the missions give him the respect he always wanted. But every favor comes with a price.
scenes.label: EVERY FAVOR HAS A PRICE

shots.match_reason: Naruto expression illustrates the imagined hope for respect
An Akatsuki member illustrates missions for the organization

scenes.text: The breaking point arrives when his new allies demand that he turn against the Hidden Leaf.
scenes.label: BETRAY THE LEAF?

shots.match_reason: Tsunade and the village leadership illustrate the demand against the Leaf
Akatsuki pressure on the village illustrates the threat

scenes.text: He refuses. Now both sides question his loyalty, and the deal that protected his friends falls apart.
scenes.label: HE REFUSES

shots.match_reason: Pain reaction shot illustrates conflict with his imagined allies

scenes.text: Naruto has to choose: prove himself to the organization, or protect the people who still believe in him.
scenes.label: WHO WOULD HE CHOOSE?

shots.match_reason: Naruto and Sakura establish the loyalty choice
Sakura illustrates the friends who still believe in him

scenes.text: Could he change the Akatsuki from inside? Or would joining them change Naruto first?
scenes.label: WHO CHANGES WHOM?

shots.match_reason: Itachi illustrates the question about changing Akatsuki
Naruto contemplating illustrates the final question
